fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detect DLL Load from Spooler Service backup folder
fields.name: Windows Spooler Service Suspicious Binary Load
fields.query: event.type="ModuleLoad" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (src.process.image.path contains "\spoolsv.exe" and (module.path contains "\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\x64\3\" or module.path contains "\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\x64\4\") and module.path contains ".dll"))
